method: TF-IDF unigrams and bigrams; lexical screening, not semantic or clinical validation

pairs.reason: Critical-result assessment versus medication due with a new contraindicating result.
Medication-specific withholding/review versus symptomatic electrolyte assessment.
Smoking-cessation assessment versus older-adult health-promotion assessment.
Client choice about disclosure to family versus family request to conceal the diagnosis from the client.
Acute mania care plan versus eating-disorder meal support.

secondaryUnigramTriage.limitations: Lexical similarity only; flagged pairs received manual objective review. This does not prove exhaustive semantic uniqueness.
